automatable_definition: A deterministic rule could decide it from the DOM and computed styles, without understanding meaning. This is about the bug, not about what axe-core happens to check.
matching_note: Detections are matched to bugs by element, not by rule name. expected_axe_rule is a prediction written before any scan.

bugs.description: Logo image has no alt attribute.
bugs.reason: A missing attribute is checkable.

bugs.description: Cart link contains only a CSS background icon and has no accessible name.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable.

bugs.description: Intro text is #999 on white, contrast about 2.8:1.
bugs.reason: Contrast ratio is computable from styles.

bugs.description: Heading level jumps from h1 to h4.
bugs.reason: Heading levels are checkable; axe treats this as best practice, not a WCAG failure.

bugs.description: Three links all read 'Click here' and go to different pages.
bugs.reason: Whether the surrounding context makes each link's purpose clear needs understanding.

bugs.description: Email input has no label.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable.

bugs.description: Topic select has no label.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable.

bugs.description: Submit button shows only a CSS background icon and has no accessible name.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable.

bugs.description: Phone input uses an invalid autocomplete token 'nope-tel'.
bugs.reason: Valid tokens are a fixed list in the HTML spec.

bugs.description: Required fields are indicated only by a red label colour.
bugs.reason: Needs knowing that the colour carries meaning.

bugs.description: Placeholder text is the only label, and it disappears when typing.
bugs.reason: The field has an accessible name; whether the instructions are adequate needs judgement.

bugs.description: Photo has alt text 'image', which describes nothing.
bugs.reason: Alt text is present; judging its quality needs the image.

bugs.description: Photo alt text is a file name, 'IMG_2041.jpg'.
bugs.reason: A file-name pattern can be decided by a rule.

bugs.description: Decorative border image has descriptive alt text; it should be alt="".
bugs.reason: Deciding an image is decorative is a judgement about meaning.

bugs.description: Embedded map iframe has no title.
bugs.reason: A missing attribute is checkable.

bugs.description: Article image has no alt attribute (it has a figcaption).
bugs.reason: A missing attribute is checkable.

bugs.description: The html element has no lang attribute.
bugs.reason: A missing attribute is checkable.

bugs.description: Share link wraps only an image with alt="", so it has no accessible name.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable.

bugs.description: Byline is #aaa on #f5f5f5, contrast about 2.1:1.
bugs.reason: Contrast ratio is computable from styles.

bugs.description: French quotation is not marked with lang="fr".
bugs.reason: Needs recognising which language the text is in.

bugs.description: List contains div children instead of li elements.
bugs.reason: Allowed list children are checkable.

bugs.description: Table header row uses bold td cells instead of th headers.
bugs.reason: Needs knowing that those cells act as headers.

bugs.description: Button contains only an unlabelled SVG and has no accessible name.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable.

bugs.description: Focusable link is hidden from assistive technology with aria-hidden="true".
bugs.reason: The attribute and focusability are checkable.

bugs.description: aria-expanded has the invalid value 'yes'.
bugs.reason: Allowed values are a fixed list.

bugs.description: div with role="button" cannot be reached or used with the keyboard.
bugs.reason: A button role without focusability is decidable.

bugs.description: The page has no title element.
bugs.reason: A missing element is checkable.

bugs.description: Image submit button has no alt text.
bugs.reason: A missing attribute is checkable.

bugs.description: Link has a positive tabindex of 3, which changes the focus order.
bugs.reason: The attribute value is checkable; axe treats it as best practice.

bugs.description: Focus outline is removed from these links with outline: none.
bugs.reason: Needs comparing focused and unfocused appearance.

bugs.description: Section heading 'Stuff' does not describe its content.
bugs.reason: Whether a heading is descriptive needs understanding.

bugs.description: Empty h2 heading.
bugs.reason: Empty content is checkable; axe treats this as best practice.

bugs.description: Icon button with no accessible name, inserted by JavaScript after the page loads.
bugs.reason: An empty accessible name is computable in the rendered DOM; it is absent from the source HTML.
